items.title: Nutrient Based Subsidy rates, rabi 2026–27
items.promise: Keep phosphatic and potassic fertilisers affordable for the rabi season, with DAP held at ₹1,350 a 50 kg bag, at an estimated cost of ₹62,370.02 crore.

stageNotes.Funded: Cabinet approved the outlay. Together with kharif 2026, P&K support of about ₹1.04 lakh crore is roughly 92 per cent above the Budget estimate.

items.tracking: Whether complex (NP/NPK) fertiliser output and sales recover towards target, and whether DAP's share of phosphate sales falls back.
items.nextCheckWhat: Department of Fertilizers production and sales data for November–December 2026

items.title: Prohibition on exporting lithium-ion battery black mass
items.promise: Keep black mass in India so that domestic recycling and refining plants get feedstock and recover more lithium, cobalt and nickel.

documents.name: DGFT Notification 49/2026-27, 10 November 2026 (via commerce ministry release)

stageNotes.Funded: A regulatory measure; no outlay. It complements the ₹1,500 crore recycling incentive scheme.
stageNotes.Implemented: In force with immediate effect, until further orders.

items.tracking: Domestic black mass payables against export parity, formally collected battery tonnage, and utilisation of domestic refining capacity.
items.nextCheckWhat: Six months of payables and collection data

items.title: Capex Support Scheme to Promote Critical Mineral Processing
items.promise: Capital support of 30 per cent of eligible investment for two lithium plants (at least 30 kt each) and two nickel plants (at least 50 kt each), capped at ₹500 crore and ₹900 crore per beneficiary, within an outlay of ₹2,814 crore over FY2026–27 to FY2030–31.

stageNotes.Notified: Scheme guidelines and the bidding process are still to come.
stageNotes.Implemented: Beneficiaries are to be chosen in two stages: technical qualification, then lowest capital support sought.

items.tracking: Selection of beneficiaries, commissioning dates, qualified output and repeat sales to battery-grade buyers.
items.nextCheckWhat: Publication of guidelines and call for bids

items.title: ₹1,500 crore incentive scheme for critical mineral recycling
items.promise: Develop capacity to separate and produce critical minerals from secondary sources such as battery waste and e-waste, under the National Critical Mineral Mission.

documents.name: Referenced in the commerce ministry release of 11 November 2026

stageNotes.Announced: Approved by the Union Cabinet in September 2025.
stageNotes.Implemented: The government says domestic recycling capacity is under-used for lack of feedstock.

items.tracking: Recycling capacity created under the scheme and its utilisation once the black mass export ban applies.

items.title: India–UK trade agreement: whisky tariff concession
items.promise: Cut India's duty on UK whisky from 150 per cent to 75 per cent on entry into force, falling to 40 per cent by the tenth year.

documents.name: Reporting on the tariff schedule and classification dispute (Vinetur, citing Reuters and The Financial Express)

stageNotes.Funded: A tariff concession; the cost is forgone customs revenue.
stageNotes.Implemented: In force from 15 July 2026, but customs is examining whether bulk Scotch qualifies.

items.tracking: Whether bulk Scotch, about four-fifths of volumes, clears at the preferential rate, and whether CBIC issues a classification instruction.
items.nextCheckWhat: A CBIC instruction or ruling on heading 2208.30 versus 2106
